package catalogclient

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestGetRevisionRuntimeContextReadsOrderedLearningTargets(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"practice_task":{},"practice_task_parts":[],"practice_task_milestones":[{"id":"milestone","learning_targets":[{"type":"capability","key":"web.catalog.render-products","version":"v1"},{"type":"concept","key":"html.semantic-elements"}]}],"solution_variants":[],"milestone_skill_tags":[],"lesson_skill_tags":[],"task_skill_tags":[]}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	runtimeContext, err := client.GetRevisionRuntimeContext(context.Background(), "revision")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get runtime context: %v", err)
	}
	targets := runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones[0].LearningTargets
	if len(targets) != 2 || targets[0] != (domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "web.catalog.render-products", Version: "v1"}) || targets[1].Key != "html.semantic-elements" {
		t.Fatalf("ordered learning targets were not decoded: %#v", targets)
	}
}

func TestGetRevisionRuntimeContextRejectsInvalidLearningTargets(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"practice_task":{},"practice_task_parts":[],"practice_task_milestones":[{"id":"milestone","learning_targets":[{"type":"mastery","key":"web.catalog"}]}],"solution_variants":[],"milestone_skill_tags":[],"lesson_skill_tags":[],"task_skill_tags":[]}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	if _, err := client.GetRevisionRuntimeContext(context.Background(), "revision"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected invalid catalog learning target to fail closed")
	}
}
